internal.title: Incident Report: High Latency in Ad Service Due to CPU Resource Exhaustion
internal.body:
On 2026-11-08 at 12:00 UTC, the ad service triggered a high latency alert with p95 latency reaching 1.8 seconds, exceeding the 1-second threshold. Concurrently, CPU utilization was observed at 98%, indicating resource exhaustion as the primary cause of the latency issue.

Diagnosis confirmed that the high CPU usage was the root cause. An operational action was taken to disable the 'adHighCpu' flag at 12:19 UTC, which led to a rapid recovery with latency dropping back to normal levels (0.12 seconds p95).

No significant error rate increase was detected, ruling out error injection as a cause.

The incident was resolved promptly after the flag adjustment, restoring service performance to expected levels.

external.title: Service Latency Issue Resolved
external.body: Between 12:00 and 12:20 UTC on 2026-11-08, the ad service experienced elevated latency, causing slower response times. The issue was identified and resolved by adjusting system settings, restoring normal service performance. We apologize for any inconvenience caused.
